data.one_liner: An in-app find bar that highlights and scrolls to text matches, including lazy-list rows.
data.what_it_does: Wraps a Flutter page to provide a Ctrl+F style in-app search bar. It automatically discovers rendered text, highlights matches, and scrolls them into view. It also supports lazy lists via specialized adapters.
use_when: A long document, release-notes page, or settings screen needs an in-app Ctrl+F.
Matches live in a lazily built ListView and off-screen rows must be counted and reachable.
avoid_when: Your page is short, fully built, and users only need a search field that filters a list.
strengths: Automatically searches text in widgets you do not own.
Supports off-screen items in lazy lists using FindableListView.
Intercepts Ctrl+F and Cmd+F across platforms including web.
weaknesses: Matching is plain text and case-insensitive by default with regex currently only planned.
Variable height items are unsupported in FindableListView.
